deviations.description: While implementing select_candidates_for_criterion(), discovered a latent pre-existing bug (not introduced by this phase, present in the original select_candidates()): `while IFS=$'\t' read -r t topic fs` silently collapses an empty middle field (bash treats tab as an IFS-whitespace character, which merges consecutive delimiters), corrupting topic_of/fs_of for any task with an empty `topic`. This made the territory criterion return empty and the topic criterion wrongly include non-topic tasks whenever a fixture had topic=null (the common case) -- which defeats Phase 2's own deliverable. Fixed by switching the jq/read field separator from @tsv (tab) to ASCII 0x1F (unit separator), which bash never collapses.
deviations.reason: Required for Phase 2's criteria to produce correct, distinct candidate pools; the plan's own Scope Hypothesis anticipated verifying this at implementation time.
